_comment: MCP servers for this repo. Prefer HTTP; reason-network is an approved tier-3 stdio exception.
WHY: agent hosts spawn stdio servers, and reaping has failed in the past. Measured
processes holding 53 GB of 58 GB RAM, 97% of them with <=1s cumulative CPU (spawned, never
used, never freed). A 'url' entry spawns nothing locally.
TO ADD A CAPABILITY, in order: (1) hosted endpoint as 'url' here; (2) an Agent Skill that
shells out per call, the way cocoindex is handled (repo-retrieve script + skill); (3) resident
stdio only with a written justification and a reaping story.
TIER 3: reason-network has no local HTTP MCP; its only HTTP endpoint is hosted off-machine.
Reaping evidence: agx runs 3476b00f (Codex, 9 trials) and af785bb6 (Claude, 28 trials):
all had zero marked reason-network mcp processes 30 seconds after session termination.
REMOVED: fetch (uvx mcp-server-fetch) -- exa's web_fetch_exa covers it; for localhost/intranet
URLs exa cannot reach, use `curl -sL "$URL" | pandoc -f html -t markdown`.
